rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a good-quality expanded blastocyst and acknowledges image limitations, but it overstates certainty from a single static image and includes some speculative grading shifts (3AA vs 3AB) and features not firmly verifiable.

Integrates age, ovarian reserve, tubal factor, endometrial thickness, prior IVF history, BMI, lifestyle, and semen parameters well, with appropriate discussion of hydrosalpinx and fresh transfer context.
Overall logic is understandable, but there are internal inconsistencies in implantation estimates and some contradictory statements about grading and prognosis that weaken coherence.

Recommendations are largely consistent with IVF practice: single embryo transfer, caution about hydrosalpinx, no overuse of add-ons, and appropriate note that morphology does not equal ploidy. Minor deviations include somewhat inflated implantation estimates and a few speculative comments.

Provides practical next steps for transfer, luteal support, hydrosalpinx/cavity confirmation, and future-cycle considerations. Useful and case-specific, though not highly detailed on thresholds or protocol contingencies.
